south-indian.name: South Indian
south-indian.title: South Indian Delights
south-indian.description: Bright, comforting dishes shaped by rice, lentils, coconut, and lively spice blends.

recipes.name: Appam
recipes.context: A lacy fermented pancake from Kerala, traditionally served with fragrant vegetable or meat stew.
steps: Soak rice, grind with coconut milk, add yeast and salt, then ferment for 8 hours.
Heat an appam pan, pour in batter, and swirl until the edges are thin and crisp.
Cover and cook until the center is set, then serve with stew.

recipes.name: Fish Curry
recipes.context: South Indian fish curry varies by coast, with tamarind and coconut creating its signature tangy richness.
steps: Marinate fish with turmeric and salt for 15 minutes.
Bloom the spices, then add coconut milk and tamarind.
Add fish and simmer gently for 15 minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Idli
recipes.context: These steamed rice-and-lentil cakes are a breakfast staple, valued for their light texture and gentle flavor.
steps: Soak rice and urad dal separately for 6 hours.
Grind, combine with salt, and ferment for 8 hours.
Steam the batter in greased molds for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.name: Kerala Parotta
recipes.context: Kerala parotta is prized for its many flaky layers, often paired with a richly spiced curry.
steps: Knead flour, oil, salt, and water, then rest the dough for 2 hours.
Stretch into thin sheets, coil, and flatten into discs.
Cook on a hot griddle with oil until golden and flaky.

recipes.name: Upma
recipes.context: A savory semolina breakfast, upma is a practical everyday dish finished with aromatic tempering.
steps: Roast semolina until aromatic and set aside.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves, then saute the vegetables.
Add water and semolina, stirring until fluffy and cooked.

recipes.name: Uttapam
recipes.context: Uttapam is a thicker cousin of dosa, topped with vegetables and enjoyed with chutney or sambar.
steps: Use fermented rice-and-lentil batter or prepare it overnight.
Pour a thick round onto a hot pan and scatter onion, tomato, and chili.
Cook both sides until golden and serve with chutney.

north-indian.name: North Indian
north-indian.title: North Indian Delights
north-indian.description: Hearty curries, tandoor flavors, and breads built for sharing around the table.

recipes.name: Aloo Gobi
recipes.context: Aloo gobi is a beloved Punjabi-style home dish where potatoes and cauliflower carry warm toasted spices.
steps: Saute cumin seeds and spices in oil.
Add chopped potatoes and cauliflower, coating them evenly.
Cover and cook until tender, about 20 minutes. Serve with roti.

recipes.name: Butter Chicken
recipes.context: Butter chicken pairs tandoori-style chicken with a silky tomato sauce and is one of Delhi's best-known exports.
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices for 2 hours.
Cook chicken in butter until tender and lightly charred.
Add tomato puree and cream, simmer for 20 minutes, and serve with naan.

recipes.name: Chole Bhature
recipes.context: This Punjabi pairing of spiced chickpeas and puffy fried bread is a celebratory street-food favorite.
steps: Soak and cook chickpeas with aromatics and spices.
Knead flour into a soft dough, rest, and roll into bhature.
Fry until puffed and serve with the spiced chickpeas.

recipes.name: Dal Makhani
recipes.context: Slow-cooked black lentils become exceptionally creamy in this Punjabi comfort food classic.
steps: Soak lentils and beans overnight, then boil until tender.
Cook with butter, spices, and a little water for an hour.
Stir in cream, garnish, and serve with naan.

recipes.name: Malai Kofta
recipes.context: Malai kofta turns paneer and potato dumplings into a rich dish often reserved for special meals.
steps: Mash paneer and potato, shape into balls, and fry until golden.
Blend cashews with aromatics for a smooth gravy.
Simmer koftas briefly in the gravy and garnish with cream.

recipes.name: Tandoori Chicken
recipes.context: Tandoori chicken gets its vivid color and smoky flavor from yogurt marinade and high-heat cooking.
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon, and spices for 4 hours.
Grill or bake at 200 C until cooked through and charred.
Rest briefly and serve with mint chutney.

korean.name: Korean
korean.title: Korean Delights
korean.description: Bold fermented flavors, sizzling grills, and comforting dishes made for sharing.

recipes.name: Bulgogi
recipes.context: Thinly sliced marinated beef becomes caramelized and tender over high heat.
steps: Marinate beef in soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, and aromatics for an hour.
Grill or pan-fry in batches until caramelized.
Serve with rice and lettuce wraps.

recipes.name: Galbi Jjim
recipes.context: Tender braised short ribs are a Korean holiday table favorite, especially for family celebrations.
steps: Blanch ribs and rinse them clean.
Braise with soy sauce, aromatics, radish, and chestnuts.
Cook until the meat is tender and the sauce glossy.

recipes.name: Haemul Pajeon
recipes.context: Crisp seafood and scallion pancakes are a popular Korean anju and rainy-day comfort food.
steps: Whisk flour, water, and egg into a loose batter.
Add seafood and green onions, then spread in a hot pan.
Cook until crisp on both sides and serve with dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Kimbap
recipes.context: Kimbap rolls are designed for portability and are a familiar picnic and lunchbox food in Korea.
steps: Season cooked rice and prepare the vegetable fillings.
Spread rice and fillings over nori, then roll tightly.
Slice into bite-sized pieces and serve.

recipes.name: Soondubu Jjigae
recipes.context: This bubbling soft tofu stew is prized for its warming broth and egg cracked in at the end.
steps: Saute pork and kimchi in a hot pot.
Add broth and tofu, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Crack an egg on top, cook until set, and serve hot.

recipes.name: Tteokbokki
recipes.context: Chewy rice cakes in a sweet-spicy gochujang sauce are a beloved Korean street-food staple.
steps: Simmer rice cakes in broth until tender.
Add gochujang, fish cake, and sugar.
Cook until the sauce thickens and coats the rice cakes.

japanese.name: Japanese
japanese.title: Japanese Delights
japanese.description: Seasonal ingredients, careful technique, and elegant balance in every bowl and plate.

recipes.name: Miso Soup
recipes.context: Miso soup is a daily Japanese staple that highlights the savory depth of fermented soybean paste.
steps: Heat dashi and add tofu and seaweed.
Turn off the heat and dissolve miso into a little broth.
Return the mixture to the pot without boiling and serve warm.

recipes.name: Onigiri
recipes.context: Hand-shaped rice balls are a portable Japanese comfort food with endless fillings and shapes.
steps: Season warm rice with salt.
Place tuna in the center and shape rice into triangles with damp hands.
Wrap with nori and serve.

recipes.name: Sashimi
recipes.context: Sashimi centers freshness and knife technique, served simply so the fish remains the focus.
steps: Keep sashimi-grade fish chilled and dry.
Slice across the grain with a sharp knife.
Arrange neatly and serve with soy sauce, wasabi, and ginger.

recipes.name: Tempura
recipes.context: Light, lacy tempura batter is a hallmark of Japanese frying technique.
steps: Whisk flour, egg, and ice water lightly; leave some lumps.
Dip shrimp or vegetables and fry in hot oil until pale golden.
Drain and serve with tempura sauce.

recipes.name: Udon
recipes.context: Udon is a versatile Japanese noodle dish served in a clear, deeply savory broth.
steps: Boil udon noodles until tender and drain.
Heat dashi with soy sauce and mirin.
Add noodles to bowls, pour over broth, and garnish.

recipes.name: Yakitori
recipes.context: Yakitori brings the convivial atmosphere of Japanese izakayas to the home grill.
steps: Marinate chicken pieces in soy sauce and mirin.
Thread onto soaked skewers and grill until lightly charred.
Brush with sauce while cooking and serve with rice.
